# Based Loans

> No-liquidation, fixed-term lending on Base (chain 8453). Borrowers deposit a token and get USDC immediately, then buy the token back at a fixed price before the due date, or walk away and keep the USDC. Lenders deposit USDC and choose which tokens they lend against, with a USDC limit per token.

Key facts:
- No liquidations. Price moves during a loan never trigger a sale.
- Three loan terms. Durations, buyback costs and the loan fee are set by the protocol and can change; read them live with get_protocol_info.
- Max loan is a share of collateral value (usually 50%), priced from DEX time-weighted averages and, for some tokens, DIA.
- Lenders are paid when borrowers buy back; if a borrower walks away, lenders receive the collateral.
- Lender deposits are held as mUSDC (0.05% fee in, 0.25% out as USDC).

## Agent tools

- [MCP server](https://github.com/0xVarius/basedloans-agents/tree/main/packages/mcp): `npx -y @basedloans/mcp`, or hosted at https://mcp.based.loans/mcp
- [TypeScript SDK](https://github.com/0xVarius/basedloans-agents/tree/main/packages/sdk): `@basedloans/sdk`
- [HTTP API](https://mcp.based.loans/v1): GET endpoints, transactions in send_calls shape
- [Agent skill](https://github.com/0xVarius/basedloans-agents/blob/main/skills/based-loans/SKILL.md)

## Guides

- [How collateral is priced](https://github.com/0xVarius/basedloans-agents/blob/main/docs/collateral-types.md): regular, two-hop, staked/share, and escrowed tokens
- [Request a token](https://based.loans/list)

- [Borrow](https://based.loans/borrow)
